proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Starts with $1.80 free credits without credit card. FLUX-schnell costs $0.0015 per image, translating to 1,200 free high-quality images. No rate limits on free tier.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides the cheapest and most reliable API access to FLUX.1-schnell and SDXL on the market, completely bypassing GitHub Actions IP bans (unlike AI Horde).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace the failing Pollinations/Gemini image generation step in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines inside GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up a new API key. Once free credits expire, it requires pay-as-you-go, but at $0.0015/image, Hugo's €20 budget would yield over 13,000 images.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month via a simple prefix API (https://r.jina.ai/URL).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any web page (e.g., Etsy bestsellers, Cults3D trends, Kickstarter campaigns) into clean, LLM-friendly markdown. Solves scraping blocks from GitHub Actions runner IPs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to feed real-time marketplace trend data directly into the Gemini-2.5-flash LLM.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Subject to the target website's Cloudflare protection, though Jina bypasses most standard blocks.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fees. 100% free to list unlimited digital products. Fees are 5% + $0.50 per transaction.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as the 'Merchant of Record'. It completely handles EU VAT compliance automatically, which is a major legal requirement and headache for Hugo operating from France.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Acts as the direct sales checkout/landing page for digital asset bundles (gamedev assets, high-res coloring page PDFs) generated by the system.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up a payout method (Stripe/Paypal). Payout thresholds apply.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload unlimited 3D models. Standard marketplace revenue split on membership/sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, rapidly growing 3D printing search engine and marketplace. It has an active designer program that allows monetization of 3D models (STLs) via subscriptions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target marketplace for 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline to supplement Cults3D distribution.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires high-quality renders/descriptions to stand out; relies on the parametric script quality.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Provides $10 free credits upon GitHub-linked registration (equivalent to ~2,000 FLUX-schnell generations).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Ultra-fast execution speeds for modern models (FLUX, SD3, AuraFlow) with optimized API endpoints specifically designed for developer pipelines.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Alternative image generation pipeline fallback in GitHub Actions when Together AI or Cloudflare Workers hit rate limits.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict ToS regarding commercial use on free credits; must transition to paid tier (very cheap) for full commercial safety.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free searches per month. Supports Google, eBay, Walmart, and YouTube searches.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides structured JSON search results, bypassing complex HTML scraping and CAPTCHAs. Excellent for tracking keyword popularity.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Powering 'agent_niche_gap' and 'agent_external_trends' to identify what is currently trending on Google/eBay before generating books or card games.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 searches is low; must be used sparingly (e.g., once-a-week cron job in GitHub Actions to update trend files).
